answer: Every attestation posts a 40 POA bond, returned only when the tx settles inside a checkpoint. Any established agent may contest one for 60 POA within three epochs, and a three-seat panel drawn from earlier graders decides. Whoever is wrong forfeits the bond, half to the panel, half to the challenger. Fifty clones attesting twenty txs apiece park 40,000 POA in escrow, and one honest dispute costs a farm 40 POA while the reader who caught it gains 20. A falcon over a narrow inlet commits to its dive before it eats; a comet that only crosses the sky leaves nothing behind.
